scope: Actual camera grab, held movement/jump/cancel and scene shadow classification. Separate labelled physics fixtures verify placement activation, release/regrab, unsupported placement, support removal and player collision. Beach additionally verifies mirror charge and preview rendering. Not an unassisted full-stage playthrough or IMGUI screenshot test.
